newest.description: Bessent says the U.S. proposed an AI incident alert system in China talks. Alex, Jamie and Rufus explain what changes and what to watch next. What we covered: • Bessent says the U.S. proposed an AI incident alert system in China talks • AP reports a lawsuit accuses Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceXAI and Google of an illegal AI slowdown pact • AP: UN leaders convene as AI safety rises on the global agenda • Trump says he will name an AI czar and create an AI Force • Reuters-style? No verified Reuters result found in-window; AP reports Trump and Xi face shared AI safety concerns Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways.
